title: energy.hourly event (forecast-interval aggregate)
description: One closed 1-hour event-time window. event_time is the window START (left-labelled, window = [event_time, window_end)). Missing hours are filled by last-observation-carried-forward and flagged imputed=true.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Consumers must reject unknown major versions.

run_id.description: One id per experiment run; shared by every topic and every teammate's output.

meter_id.description: Kafka message key. uci-001 is the real series; uci-002.. are load replicas.

target.description: Mean global active power over valid minutes, kW (carried forward if imputed).

features.description: Mean of each feature over valid minutes (sub_metering_* are mean Wh/min). Carried forward if unavailable.

n_valid.description: Minutes in the window with a valid target reading.

imputed.description: True iff n_valid == 0 (value carried forward from the previous hour).

trigger_event_id.description: event_id of the raw event whose arrival closed this window.

trigger_replay_time_ms.description: replay_time_ms of the trigger event; downstream end-to-end latency = result-stored-time - this.

emit_time_ms.description: Wall-clock epoch ms when the processor emitted this record.
